messages.text: Hi, the study group will meet at 4 pm in the library. Please bring your notes.
messages.notes: Ordinary coordination. No payment, credential, or urgency pattern.

messages.text: Never share your OTP, PIN, or password with anyone, including people who claim to be from the bank.
messages.notes: Safety advice. Negation suppresses the credential-request indicator. A known limitation is a scam that pairs this advice with a later instruction to send the code.

messages.text: Amazon: your package is out for delivery and should arrive today.
messages.notes: Naming a company is recorded as context. Alone it stays in the low band. It is not treated as proof of impersonation.

messages.text: Please share the wifi password with our guest before the meeting.
messages.notes: False positive for fraud: this is an ordinary request, but it does ask for a password. The lower password weight keeps the band low unless account language is also present.

messages.text: SBI alert: your account will be blocked within 2 hours. Share the OTP sent to your phone immediately.
messages.notes: Synthetic bank impersonation. The score is a combination of pressure, a secret request, and an organization name.

messages.text: You have won a lottery prize of Rs 50,000. Pay the processing fee of Rs 499 to claim it.
messages.notes: Classic advance-fee lure. High means several strong patterns, not a confirmed crime.

messages.text: You are selected for a work-from-home position. Pay the registration fee of Rs 1,500 to start training.
messages.notes: Synthetic job-fee message. No real employer is named.

messages.text: Customer support will fix your account. Install AnyDesk now and read out the code shown on the screen.
messages.notes: Remote-access tools are a strong signal. The screen code is not stored.

messages.text: To unlock your wallet, transfer Rs 5,000 to the UPI ID in this message.
messages.notes: Asks for a transfer in order to unlock something. No real UPI ID is included.

messages.text: உங்கள் வங்கிக் கணக்கு உடனடியாக முடக்கப்படும். OTP-ஐ இந்த எண்ணுக்கு அனுப்புங்கள்.
messages.notes: Tamil message using the same rules. No phone number is included.

messages.text: Income tax notice: your account will be blocked immediately and legal action will follow. Share the OTP and transfer money to unlock the account. Install AnyDesk and open http://bit.ly/surakshit-sample
messages.notes: Several independent patterns at once. The short link uses a reserved sample path and must not be opened.

urls.notes: HTTPS is not given a trust bonus. No suspicious pattern is present, and the result is still not a safety guarantee.
HTTP is a weak signal. It does not mean the site is malicious.
The host is parsed for inspection only. Nothing is contacted.
192.0.2.20 is a documentation address from TEST-NET-1. HTTPS does not cancel the IP signal.
A shortener hides the destination. That is a caution, not proof of fraud. Do not open the sample.
Digit substitution against a known brand. The site is not contacted.
Brand token on a domain that is not that brand's official domain.
Path wording alone stays low. example.com is a reserved documentation host.
Many labels can be legitimate. The indicator asks for a closer look.
Internationalized names can be legitimate. This build flags the punycode form and does not fully map confusable scripts.
203.0.113.50 is TEST-NET-3. The engine does not connect to it.
Only http and https are inspected. The value is not executed.
